title: Gelatin based flat flax bread
ingredients: 1/2 a heaped teaspoon of gelatin powder - from a sachet
method: Mix all the dry ingredients in a warm bowl.
Add enough boiling water to mix a stiff dough.
Heat a thick based pan until smoking.
Roll each flat between cling film.
Dust one side with flax and place this down onto the hot pan.
Cook on the smoking pan, flipping regularly and pressing down with a spatula, until well cooked. This could take a long time.
